description: Update the saved content automation rule identified by id using the configuration in body. Overwrites the settings that control future generation, destinations, and approval behavior; active rules can schedule or publish content according to those settings. Returns the updated rule. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_content_automation
title: Update Content Automation Rule
